translation: (From the Yuhan Jing. One version: 3 ge of Mangxiao, 5 Sangpiaoxiao (mantis egg cases), and 4 fen of Dahuang, boiled to take 1.5 sheng, taken warm 5 ge, slightly purging, heals. Originally it says to take the Chaihu Tang twice to resolve the exterior and obtain healing. One version adds Mangxiao, Dahuang, and Sangpiaoxiao on the outside; this is it.)
